title: Make the Adversary Spend More: Stateful Deception as a Cost-Exchange Primitive for AI-Era Cyber Defense
abstract: arXiv:2611.34770v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are transforming the economics of intrusion by reducing the attacker's cost to scan and adapt, while tempting defenders into unbounded compute. We argue that cyber deception should be judged by the cost exchange it imposes, not by realism or detection, and that the primitive making that exchange favorable is adversary-specific persistent state. Rather than a honeypot that resets or merges sessions, each recognized adversary re-enters the world it believes it has compromised, kept coherent with its own past actions and isolated from every other adversary, while the language model acts only as a constrained renderer of explicit state, never as its store. We formalize the trade-off as a Deception Exchange Rate (DER), relating mission-weighted adversary effort burned to defender resources spent, and instantiate it in an SSH honeypot pairing Cowrie with a local LLM. translated_title: 让攻击者付出更多代价：有状态欺骗作为AI时代网络防御的成本交换原语
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正在改变网络入侵的经济格局：它们降低了攻击者进行扫描和适应的成本，同时诱导防御者陷入无限制的计算消耗。我们主张，网络欺骗的评判标准应当是其强加给攻击者的成本交换，而非仿真度或检测能力，而使这种交换有利于防御方的关键原语是针对特定攻击者的持久状态。与那种会重置或合并会话的传统蜜罐不同，每个被识别的攻击者会重新进入它自认为已经攻破的世界——这个世界与其自身的过去行为保持连贯，并与其他所有攻击者相互隔离——而语言模型仅作为显式状态的受限渲染器，绝不充当其存储。我们将这种权衡形式化为“欺骗交换率”，将攻击者消耗的任务加权工作量与防御者花费的资源联系起来，并通过将 Cowrie 与本地 LLM 相结合的 SSH 蜜罐加以实现。本文聚焦于防御侧……
tldr: 该论文提出以成本交换为核心的有状态欺骗防御框架：为每个被识别的攻击者维护与其历史行为一致且相互隔离的持久化欺骗世界，由LLM充当受限的状态渲染器，并形式化出“欺骗交换率”（DER）以量化攻击者与防御者之间的资源消耗比。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes stateful deception as a cost-exchange primitive for AI-era cyber defense, maintaining persistent, adversary-specific honeypot worlds coherent with each attacker's own past actions while the LLM serves only as a constrained state renderer, formalized via a Deception Exchange Rate (DER) measuring adversary effort burned versus defender resources spent.
